name: [UPD] 🤪Super Epic Crazy Tag
desc:
⚠️ The game is still in its early stages! Expect bugs and frequent shutdowns ⚠️

🎉 Welcome to Super Epic Crazy Tag! 🎉
Run, jump, and use your powers! Do everything it takes to evade the chasers until the time runs out!

💰 Earn Coins by playing, tagging, and surviving!
💥 Buy cool skills to use on other players!
👍 Thumbs Up & Favorite for more updates, maps, and items!

Can you become the fastest, sneakiest runner in the game? 🏃‍♂️🔥
